item.title: GROOM_MONITOR=true run_agent sets global shell var — bleeds into developer agents
item.intent: GROOM_MONITOR must not persist beyond groom agents; developer and validator must run with GROOM_MONITOR unset
steps: Understand that VAR=val shell_function sets VAR globally in current bash shell (unlike external commands)
Confirm: after auto-groom in run_sprint_loop (lines 2804/2806), GROOM_MONITOR=true persists into subsequent run_agent calls for developer and validator
Fix by adding an explicit reset after each groom run_agent call: add GROOM_MONITOR= on the line immediately after each GROOM_MONITOR=true run_agent invocation (lines 2804, 2806, 3271)
Confirm run_groom_flow (line 3271) has the same issue and apply the same fix there
Run shellcheck on .aishore/aishore — confirm zero new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: After auto-groom runs in a multi-sprint session, developer and validator agent log output contains no backlog monitoring progress messages (no 'updated — N items' lines from _check_groom_progress)
